description: Phase 4: Next.js 15 + Supabase + Cloudflare full-stack migration. 7 plans, 20 user stories across 4 waves.

userStories.title: Create Next.js 15 project + install all dependencies
userStories.description: Initialize Next.js 15 App Router project with TypeScript. Install all deps: next, @supabase/ssr, @opennextjs/cloudflare, react-leaflet, recharts, react-big-calendar, tailwindcss 4.x, vitest. Create package.json, tsconfig.json, next.config.ts, .gitignore.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json exists with all required dependencies listed
tsconfig.json configured for Next.js 15 + strict mode
next.config.ts exports valid config
.gitignore covers .env.local, node_modules, .next
npm install completes without errors
npx tsc --noEmit reports no errors
userStories.notes: Wave 1 — infrastructure foundation. No Supabase credentials needed yet.

userStories.title: Configure Tailwind CSS 4.x + global styles + SVG sprite
userStories.description: Set up Tailwind CSS 4.x with @theme block defining all color tokens and spacing tokens per 04-UI-SPEC.md. Create globals.css with Tailwind imports, CSS custom properties, and base styles. Create SVG sprite sheet for icons used across the app.
acceptanceCriteria: globals.css exists with Tailwind @import and @theme block
@theme block defines color tokens matching UI-SPEC (green primary, purple secondary, gray shades)
Spacing tokens defined in @theme
SVG sprite sheet created with sidebar nav icons (dashboard, calendar, map, settings)
npx tsc --noEmit passes
userStories.notes: Wave 1. Reference: 04-UI-SPEC.md for exact color values and spacing scale.

userStories.title: Create .env.local template + Vitest config + test file skeletons
userStories.description: Create .env.local with placeholder values for Supabase URL, anon key, service role key. Create vitest.config.ts. Create skeleton test files for middleware, dashboard API, and tags API with placeholder tests.
acceptanceCriteria: .env.local exists with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY placeholders
vitest.config.ts exports valid config with defineConfig
tests/middleware.test.ts skeleton exists with at least one placeholder test
tests/api/dashboard.test.ts skeleton exists with at least one placeholder test
tests/api/tags.test.ts skeleton exists with at least one placeholder test
npx vitest run executes and reports results
userStories.notes: Wave 1. Tests are placeholders — real tests come in Wave 3 (04-04).

userStories.title: Create PostgreSQL DDL migration file (5 tables + RLS + indexes)
userStories.description: Convert SQLite schema/init_db.sql to PostgreSQL DDL. Create migration file in supabase/migrations/. Convert types: INTEGER→BIGSERIAL for PKs, BLOB→BYTEA, no changes needed for TEXT/INTEGER/BOOLEAN. Add Row Level Security policies for 3 roles (admin/manager/readonly). Add indexes on foreign keys and query columns.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration file created in supabase/migrations/ with timestamp prefix
5 tables defined: exhibition_brand, exhibition_edition, data_provenance, manual_tag_history, crawl_log
RLS enabled on all tables
RLS policies: admin=all, manager=select+update tags, readonly=select only
Indexes on brand_id FK, industry_l2, competition_relation, year columns
SQL syntax valid PostgreSQL (no SQLite-isms)
userStories.notes: Wave 2 (CC). Users table handled by Supabase Auth automatically. Reference: schema/init_db.sql and 04-RESEARCH.md for conversion rules.

userStories.title: [BLOCKING] Push schema migration to Supabase database
userStories.description: Push the migration file to Supabase PostgreSQL. Requires SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in .env.local. Verify tables exist in Supabase dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration pushed successfully (npx supabase db push or supabase migration up)
All 5 tables visible in Supabase Table Editor
RLS policies visible and enabled in Supabase dashboard
Indexes confirmed created
userStories.notes: SKIPPED 2026-05-06: .env.local contains placeholder credentials only (sb_publishable_/sb_secret_ prefixes look truncated). Real Supabase project credentials needed to run npx supabase db push or supabase migration up.

userStories.title: Create Supabase client files + auth middleware + type definitions
userStories.description: Create lib/supabase/server.ts (server client with cookies), lib/supabase/client.ts (browser client), lib/supabase/middleware.ts (session refresh). Create middleware.ts at root for route protection. Create lib/types.ts with Database type, Brand, Edition, and API response types.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/supabase/server.ts creates server client with @supabase/ssr
lib/supabase/client.ts creates browser client
lib/supabase/middleware.ts handles session refresh
middleware.ts at root guards /dashboard, /calendar, /map routes (redirect to /login if no session)
lib/types.ts exports Database, Brand, Edition, DashboardResponse, ApiError types
All TypeScript types match the PostgreSQL schema exactly
npx tsc --noEmit passes
userStories.notes: Wave 2 (CC). Can be done without real Supabase credentials (types only).

userStories.title: Create root layout + Sidebar component
userStories.description: Create app/layout.tsx with HTML structure, metadata, font loading. Create components/layout/Sidebar.tsx with 4 nav items (Dashboard, Calendar, Map, Setting), active state highlighting, admin-only visibility for Setting. Sidebar collapsed/expanded states optional.
acceptanceCriteria: app/layout.tsx renders children with sidebar
components/layout/Sidebar.tsx has 4 nav items with SVG icons
Active route highlighted with green background
Setting nav item only visible when user role is admin
Sidebar matches UI-SPEC colors (dark background, white text, green active)
npx tsc --noEmit passes
userStories.notes: Wave 2 (Cursor). Can develop with mock user context before Supabase Auth is wired. Reference: 04-UI-SPEC.md Sidebar section.

userStories.title: Create KPI card component (KpiCard + TrendBadge) + FilterTabs component
userStories.description: Create components/ui/KpiCard.tsx showing large number, label, and TrendBadge (↑↓→ with color: green/red/gray). Create components/ui/FilterTabs.tsx with 3 rows: industry_l1→l2 cascade, competition relation multi-select, MDS related single-select. All states: loading skeleton, empty, error, populated.
acceptanceCriteria: KpiCard renders: label, large number (formatted), TrendBadge with arrow icon and percentage
TrendBadge: green↑ for rising, red↓ for falling, gray→ for stable
KpiCard has loading skeleton variant (pulsing gray placeholder)
FilterTabs has 3 rows matching PRD §5 exact spec
Row 1: industry_l1 single-select, industry_l2 cascades from l1 selection
Row 2: competition_relation multi-select (全部/竞争对手/潜在伙伴/新进入者)
Row 3: mds_related single-select (全部/MFC/Reha China/无)
Pill/tab style: rounded-full, green when selected, gray when not
All components match UI-SPEC color tokens and spacing
npx tsc --noEmit passes
userStories.notes: Wave 2 (Cursor). Reference: 04-UI-SPEC.md KPI card and FilterTabs sections. PRD §5 for filter spec.

userStories.title: Create IndustryPieChart component
userStories.description: Create components/charts/IndustryPieChart.tsx using recharts PieChart. Shows industry_l2 distribution. Color palette matching 04-UI-SPEC.md chart colors. Includes loading, empty, and error states.
acceptanceCriteria: PieChart renders from data prop: { name: string, value: number }[]
Colors use UI-SPEC chart palette
Legend positioned below chart
Tooltip on hover showing name, value, percentage
Loading state: skeleton circle placeholder
Empty state: '暂无数据' message centered
Error state: error message with retry hint
npx tsc --noEmit passes
userStories.notes: Wave 2 (Cursor). Reference: 04-UI-SPEC.md chart section. Image #2 'Application by Department' for style reference.

userStories.title: Implement Dashboard aggregation API + Brand detail API
userStories.description: Create app/api/dashboard/route.ts — GET endpoint accepting query params: industry_l2, competition_relation (comma-separated), mds_related. Returns aggregated KPI data (total area_sqm, exhibitors_count, visitors_count, organizer count) + brand list + industry_l2 distribution. Create app/api/brands/[id]/route.ts — GET brand detail with editions.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/dashboard?industry_l2=&competition_relation=&mds_related= returns valid JSON
Response includes: kpis { total_area, total_exhibitors, total_visitors, total_organizers }, brands[], industryDistribution[]
Filters apply correctly: industry_l2 exact match, competition_relation IN filter, mds_related IN filter
GET /api/brands/[id] returns brand detail + all editions ordered by year DESC
API returns 404 for non-existent brand_id
All responses typed with lib/types.ts types
npx tsc --noEmit passes
npx vitest run — dashboard and brand API tests pass
userStories.notes: Wave 3 (CC). Replaces Phase 3 FastAPI dashboard endpoint. API routes built with mocked Supabase client for tests. Runtime requires real Supabase credentials.

userStories.title: Implement tagging API + User management API
userStories.description: Create app/api/brands/[id]/tags/route.ts — PATCH endpoint for updating brand tags (competition_relation, mds_related, strategic_relevance, etc.), writes to manual_tag_history. Create app/api/users/route.ts — GET (list users, admin only) and user count.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/brands/[id]/tags accepts JSON body with tag fields
Validates that only allowed tag fields are updated
Writes old→new values to manual_tag_history table
Returns updated brand object
Returns 401 if no valid session, 403 if readonly role
GET /api/users returns user list (admin only, 403 for others)
All tag field validations match PRD §3.3 field definitions
npx vitest run — tags and users API tests pass
userStories.notes: Wave 3 (CC). Replaces Phase 2 tag_api.py. Reference: tag_api.py for business logic.

userStories.title: Create seed-users.ts + wrangler.jsonc + open-next.config.ts
userStories.description: Create scripts/seed-users.ts — creates 30 users in Supabase Auth: 2 admin, 8 manager, 20 readonly. Each with email/password/role. Create wrangler.jsonc for Cloudflare Workers config. Create open-next.config.ts for @opennextjs/cloudflare adapter.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/seed-users.ts creates users via Supabase Admin API
30 users created with correct role distribution (2/8/20)
Each user has email format: userNN@mwlab.internal
Admin user credentials documented (not in committed file)
wrangler.jsonc has name, main, compatibility_date, vars
open-next.config.ts exports valid config
npx tsc --noEmit passes
userStories.notes: Wave 3 (CC). Requires SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. Seeds run once manually, not in CI.

userStories.title: Create login page + root route redirect
userStories.description: Create app/login/page.tsx with email+password form, Supabase Auth signIn. Create app/page.tsx that redirects to /dashboard if authenticated, /login if not. Style per 04-UI-SPEC.md LoginPage contract.
acceptanceCriteria: /login renders email + password form with submit button
Form validates: email format, password not empty
Successful login redirects to /dashboard
Failed login shows error message (invalid credentials)
Form has loading state during auth (spinner on button)
Page matches UI-SPEC LoginPage: centered card, logo area, clean white bg
Root route / redirects correctly based on session
npx tsc --noEmit passes
Browser verification: login flow works end to end
userStories.notes: Wave 3 (Cursor). Reference: 04-UI-SPEC.md LoginPage contract. Requires Supabase project with Auth enabled. Browser verification deferred (needs real Supabase credentials).

userStories.title: Create Dashboard main page (FilterTabs + KPI cards + PieChart)
userStories.description: Create app/dashboard/page.tsx composing FilterTabs + 4 KpiCards + IndustryPieChart. Fetches from /api/dashboard with current filter state. URL params sync filter state (?industry_l2=&relation=&mds=). Responsive grid layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard page renders FilterTabs row at top
4 KPI cards in a row: 展览面积, 展商数量, 观众数量, 展览集团
Each KPI card shows value + TrendBadge
IndustryPieChart below KPI cards
Changing filters triggers API call and updates all components
Filter state synced to URL query params (shareable/bookmarkable)
Loading state: KPI cards show skeleton, chart shows spinner
Empty state: '没有匹配的展会数据' with suggestion to change filters
Error state: error banner with retry button
Browser verification: filter interaction works end to end
userStories.notes: Wave 3 (Cursor). Uses components from 04-03 (already built). Requires /api/dashboard from 04-04.

userStories.title: Create Calendar page (react-big-calendar)
userStories.description: Create app/calendar/page.tsx with react-big-calendar in month/week views. Shows exhibitions as events (date_start to date_end). Click event → modal with exhibition details (name_cn, venue, city, exhibitors_count). Uses dynamic import with ssr:false.
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar renders in month view by default
Week view available via toolbar toggle
Exhibitions displayed as events spanning date_start to date_end
Click event opens detail modal with: name_cn, venue, city, exhibitors_count
Events color-coded by competition_relation (competitor=red, partner=green, neutral=gray)
Dynamic import with ssr:false (react-big-calendar is client-only)
Loading state during data fetch
Empty state when no exhibitions in visible month
npx tsc --noEmit passes
Browser verification: calendar renders and events are clickable
userStories.notes: Wave 3 (Cursor). react-big-calendar CSS import required. Reference: 04-UI-SPEC.md Calendar section.

userStories.title: Create Map page (react-leaflet)
userStories.description: Create app/map/page.tsx with react-leaflet MapContainer. Aggregate exhibitions by city → circle markers sized by count. Click marker → popup with city name + exhibition count + top 3 exhibitions. China-centered initial view. Uses dynamic import with ssr:false.
acceptanceCriteria: Map renders centered on China (lat: 35, lng: 105, zoom: 4)
Circle markers at each city with exhibitions
Marker radius proportional to exhibition count (log scale)
Click marker shows popup: city name, count, top 3 exhibition names
Markers color-coded: China=blue, International=orange
Legend overlay showing color meaning and size scale
Dynamic import with ssr:false (react-leaflet is client-only)
Loading state: map placeholder with spinner
Empty state: world map with '暂无展会地理数据' overlay
npx tsc --noEmit passes
Browser verification: map renders and markers are interactive
userStories.notes: Wave 3 (Cursor). Leaflet CSS import required. Use OpenStreetMap tiles (free, no API key). Reference: 04-UI-SPEC.md Map section.

userStories.title: Create Setting page (admin-only)
userStories.description: Create app/setting/page.tsx accessible only to admin role. Shows user list table (from /api/users), data update status panel (last crawl time, record counts), and system info. Redirect non-admin users to /dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: /setting redirects to /dashboard for non-admin users
User list table: email, role badge, last login, status
Role badges color-coded: admin=red, manager=blue, readonly=gray
Data status panel: last crawl time, total brands count, total editions count
System info: Next.js version, Supabase project ref, deploy time
Loading state: table skeleton rows
Error state: '无法加载用户数据' with retry
npx tsc --noEmit passes
Browser verification: admin can access /setting, manager/readonly redirected
userStories.notes: Wave 3 (Cursor). Admin-only enforced by both middleware (route) and API (data). Reference: 04-UI-SPEC.md Setting section.

userStories.title: Create data migration script (SQLite → Supabase PostgreSQL) + execute
userStories.description: Create scripts/migrate-data.ts that reads from mwlab.db (SQLite) via better-sqlite3, transforms data for PostgreSQL compatibility, and inserts into Supabase. Handle ID conflicts, NULL handling, JSON fields. Execute migration and verify row counts.
acceptanceCriteria: scripts/migrate-data.ts exists and runs via npx tsx scripts/migrate-data.ts
Migrates 5 tables in order: exhibition_brand → exhibition_edition → data_provenance → manual_tag_history → crawl_log
Handles SQLite→PostgreSQL type conversions (INTEGER PK→BIGINT, BLOB→BYTEA)
Verifies row counts match between SQLite source and PostgreSQL target
Logs progress per table (migrated X / total Y rows)
Migration is idempotent (can re-run safely, skips existing rows)
Dry-run mode: --dry-run flag that counts without inserting
userStories.notes: Wave 4 (CC). Requires both local SQLite access and Supabase credentials. Current data: ~3.4K brands.

userStories.title: [CHECKPOINT] Full test suite + Cloudflare Workers local preview
userStories.description: Run complete vitest test suite (all tests must pass). Execute seed-users.ts. Run wrangler dev for local Cloudflare Workers preview. Verify all pages render and API endpoints respond correctly. This is the final checkpoint before production deploy.
acceptanceCriteria: All vitest tests pass (0 failures)
TypeScript compilation clean (0 errors)
npm run build succeeds
All 5 pages render without error: /login, /dashboard, /calendar, /map, /setting
All 4 API endpoints respond correctly: dashboard, brands/[id], brands/[id]/tags, users
Login flow: email+password → session cookie → access protected routes
RBAC: readonly user cannot access /setting or PATCH tags
wrangler dev starts and serves the app locally
Browser verification: full E2E walkthrough of all pages
userStories.notes: Wave 4 (CC). Final checkpoint. If any test fails, fix before marking complete.
